ALPHA: Alpha creates Beta; Beta creates Omega. Upgrading Alpha adds Innate, not an upgraded Beta. Generated cards can be upgraded separately in combat.
BETA: The upgrade reduces Beta's cost from 2 to 1; it still creates an unupgraded Omega unless another effect upgrades the generated card.
OMEGA: Deals non-attack damage at the end of the player's turn. Strength, Vulnerable, and Double Damage do not modify this damage.
BECOME_ALMIGHTY: Wish option, not a normal hand/deck card. Its upgrade state is inherited from Wish; Master Reality does not upgrade it.
LIVE_FOREVER: Wish option, not a normal hand/deck card. Its upgrade state is inherited from Wish; Master Reality does not upgrade it.
FAME_AND_FORTUNE: Wish option, not a normal hand/deck card. Its upgrade state is inherited from Wish; Master Reality does not upgrade it. Ectoplasm prevents the gold gain.
WISH: Creates and immediately resolves a choice card without putting that card into hand or the deck. Upgrade Wish itself to improve the choices; Master Reality does not upgrade the choice.
BLASPHEMY: Blasphemer applies 99999 HP loss at the start of the next player turn, rather than an unconditional death operation. The wiki reports Buffer, Intangible, and resurrection interactions.
Although detrimental, Blasphemer is treated as a positive buff for Artifact/Orange Pellets purposes. Entering another stance does not remove it.
BURN: Burn+ exists but is not a normal player-upgrade target. Hexaghost creates/upgrades Burns through Inferno. Preserve the enemy-created upgraded state.
End-of-turn Burn damage can be blocked. Burn discards itself even when otherwise retained or kept by Runic Pyramid.
CLASH: The all-Attack hand condition also matters for indirect/free plays. The wiki reports that Havoc still exhausts an unplayable Clash even though it is not played.
CONJURE_BLADE: Store the generated Expunger's hit count when Conjure Blade resolves. Conjure Blade+ adds one hit; it does not upgrade Expunger's per-hit damage. Chemical X adds two hits.
Zero-hit Expungers are possible. Free/duplicated X-cost plays need to preserve the appropriate X value without necessarily consuming energy.
EXPUNGER: Costs 1 energy, not X energy. X is a stored hit count inherited from Conjure Blade at creation, not the player's current energy. Its own upgrade changes damage per hit from 9 to 15.
CORRUPTION: Skill cost replacement and exhaust-on-play are effects of the power. The Corruption power card itself does not exhaust. Additional copies do not stack the power.
DEVA_FORM: Track both current energy gain and its growth. The first additional energy arrives on the next player turn. Upgrading removes Ethereal, not the growth mechanic.
DEUS_EX_MACHINA: Exhausts itself when drawn, after creating Miracles. It is unplayable; the self-exhaust flag does not imply a normal on-play trigger.
DODGE_AND_ROLL: The next-turn Block amount incorporates Dexterity and Frail when the card is played, not when that delayed Block is delivered.
ECHO_FORM: The upgrade removes Ethereal. Multiple power stacks double the first corresponding number of cards, rather than repeatedly doubling only the first card.
Repeated X-cost plays reuse X. The repeated play counts toward card-play counters and triggers; other doubling effects do not recursively double that repeat.
ESTABLISHMENT: Triggers on actual Retain, including retention granted by other cards. Runic Pyramid's prevention of discard is not Retain and does not by itself trigger Establishment.
FISSION: Unupgraded Fission removes Orbs without their Evoke effects; Fission+ evokes them. Both variants gain energy and draw based on the Orbs removed/evoked.
GENETIC_ALGORITHM: Block is persistent per-card state across combats, not always the printed starting value of 1. Playing the card permanently adds 2 Block, or 3 when upgraded.
Repeated plays can increase the value between plays. The wiki explicitly reports an Omniscience exception; verify its copy/persistence behavior before implementing that interaction.
LESSON_LEARNED: Fatal upgrades the permanent deck, not merely a combat copy. Fatal excludes Minions, the Awakened One's first phase, and non-final Darkling kills.
NIGHTMARE: Copies arrive next turn. Persistent cost/value changes can be copied; turn-only discounts expire rather than carrying over. Copies exceeding the hand limit go to the discard pile.
NORMALITY: Enforces a card-play limit only while currently in hand. Removing/discarding it can permit further plays; drawing it after three plays immediately prevents additional plays. Duplicated and autoplayed cards count too.
OMNISCIENCE: Chosen draw-pile cards play twice without their normal energy cost and are exhausted. X-cost plays use energy remaining after paying Omniscience without consuming it.
The wiki reports special ordering for Time Warp and chained Omniscience, but Normality and Velvet Choker remain hard play limits. Turn-ending chosen cards can interrupt the repeat/chain.
PARASITE: Removal or transformation from the permanent deck causes max-HP loss; exhausting a combat copy does not.
PRESSURE_POINTS: First apply Mark to one selected enemy, then cause all enemies to lose HP equal to their own Mark. This is not an Attack damage effect.
REGRET: Snapshot hand size when End Turn is pressed, including Regret itself. End-of-turn draws do not enlarge this count. Regret discards itself before ordinary retention.
RITUAL_DAGGER: Damage growth is persistent per individual card across combats. Upgrade increases Fatal growth from 3 to 5, not the initial 15 damage.
Fatal excludes Minions, the Awakened One's first phase, and non-final Darkling kills. Copies have independent future growth.
RUSHDOWN: Entering Wrath from another stance triggers draw; trying to enter Wrath while already in Wrath does not. The stance-changing card is placed in its destination pile before the triggered draw, so it can be redrawn.
SANDS_OF_TIME: The cost reduction is per-card combat state and triggers on Retain, not simply remaining in hand. Establishment can provide an additional reduction.
SEARING_BLOW: The upgraded variant represents +1 only. Store an integer upgrade count n; base damage is 12 + n*(n+7)/2. Further in-combat upgrades also increase damage.
The wiki reports extra-upgrade quirks when generated under Master Reality; consult the Bugs section before implementing generation/copy interactions.
VAULT: Ends the player turn and begins another player turn while skipping the enemy turn and end-of-round phase. Do not model this as a plain extra energy/draw action.
Player-turn end/start effects still occur, but enemy-turn/end-of-round effects are skipped. Blasphemer still triggers on the new player turn. A doubled Vault can end the turn before its second play.
